cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 (XDP): MSH3 modifies somatic CCCTCT repeat instability
cases.mechanism_detail: Genetic association study in XDP individuals showing MSH3 variants modify somatic expansion/contraction of the SVA CCCTCT repeat in blood and brain and age at onset; the SVA's effect on TAF1 is not studied here.
cases.quote: we found that MSH3 modifies repeat expansion and contraction in blood as well as age at onset
